name: @xyb-community/takayasu-workbench
description: 本机优先的大动脉炎（Takayasu Arteritis）确诊档案与随访资料整理工作台：受累血管节段记录、炎症指标（ESR/CRP）趋势、四肢血压成对对比、激素与免疫抑制剂剂量记录、影像随访与复诊准备（品牌名「小弓宝」为占位，待晨审追认）

scripts.check: node --check dsh/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node scripts/check-workbench-package.mjs . && node scripts/check-host-contract.mjs && node scripts/smoke-activate.mjs && node scripts/check-probe-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-version-literal.mjs && node scripts/check-static-refs.mjs && node scripts/check-choice-limit.mjs && node scripts/check-assertion-strength.mjs && node scripts/check-derivative-leftovers.mjs . && node scripts/check-trial-snapshot.mjs . --if-present && node scripts/check-primer-links.mjs && node scripts/check-schema.mjs && node scripts/build-version.mjs --check && node scripts/build-client.mjs --check && node scripts/migrate-public.mjs --check && node scripts/check-public-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-wording.mjs && node scripts/check-trial-matching.mjs . && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run test && npm run audit
